verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard that shows each state's requirements and upcoming deadlines and lets users take necessary actions. It also bundles a compliance subscription aimed at keeping companies compliant, which plausibly covers state filings. However, no evidence explicitly says the platform files annual reports or franchise tax for the founder. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that annual reports and franchise tax (e.g., Delaware) are filed through the platform, on-time filing guarantees or reminders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can file annual reports and franchise tax on time through the platform

citations.quote: Click on a state to view requirements, upcoming deadlines, and take any necessary actions.
manage everything from your compliance dashboard.
forget the stress of staying compliant.
It takes care of your business's entire back office, including accounting, compliance, virtual address, and tax.
